title: A RESPAWN IS NOT THROWN THROUGH A STRONGHOLD FENCE
why: Cloud robustness hunt. Every body remembers which side of each stronghold fence it is on (inside or outside), and the fence keeps it there unless it walks through the open gate. In the 2 player DEMO a player who dies inside a compound respawns somewhere else on the same raid, but kept the inside mark, so the first time he walked within 640 of that compound from outside, behind the fence, he was thrown through the mesh to the inside. Proven in headless Chromium on v27.32 (2 player rules, seed 1): compound breached, the player inside (side 1), killed, respawned 3957 from it with the mark still inside; walked to 360 from the centre behind the fence, and one frame later he stood 223 from it, inside a 240 fence. The host coming off the bench takes the same respawn. Now a respawn forgets the fence sides, so each is taken again from where he lands. Nothing else about the fences changes.
now: In the 2 player DEMO, dying inside a stronghold no longer drags you through its fence when you come back near it.
